title: Use OptiSweep Go-to Function to Send an AGV (Not in a Task) to a Selected Square
summary: Send an AGV that is not currently in a task to a selected destination square using the OptiSweep Go-to function. This is intended for quick recovery scenarios (e.g., when a tipper is down and an AGV will not leave), including dropping the AGV off at the hospital so it can pick up a new task after the tote is removed.
when_to_use: Use when you need quick recovery by sending an AGV that is not in a task to a chosen square (for example, to drop it off at the hospital when a tipper is down and the AGV will not leave).
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for deeper diagnostics if the AGV does not move after Confirm; the segment does not provide troubleshooting steps for that condition.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Go-to workflow (select AGV → Go to → select destination square → Confirm) and verify the AGV responds as expected.
L2_support: Provide deeper diagnostics/escalation support if the AGV does not move after Confirm or if it still cannot pick up a new task after the tote is removed.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep operator UI that provides Robot Selection and Go-to controls (surface not explicitly named in the segment).
RMS / fleet status UI (for fleet/AGV status visibility, if needed during verification).

system_preconditions: The target AGV is identified as “not in a task.”

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Robot Selection area and the Go-to workflow: select an AGV, select Go to, select destination square, and select Confirm; includes the recovery use case (tipper down, AGV not leaving, drop off at hospital, pick up new task after tote removed).

steps.title: Open the OptiSweep interface with Robot Selection and Go-to controls
steps.purpose: Access the controls needed to select an AGV and issue a Go-to command.
steps.instruction: Open the OptiSweep interface that contains the Robot Selection and Go-to controls shown in the segment.
steps.expected_result: You can see the Robot Selection area and the Go-to option/button, along with a destination square selection area and a Confirm control.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI shows the Robot Selection controls and the Go-to workflow elements (destination square selection and Confirm) ready to use.
steps.failure_condition: The Robot Selection area or Go-to option/Confirm control is not available/visible, preventing you from proceeding with the Go-to workflow.

actions.label: Verify Go-to workflow controls are visible
actions.exact_action: Open the OptiSweep interface that contains the Robot Selection and Go-to controls shown in the segment.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript/segment context: “Go-to function can send an AGV not in a task to any square… Slide steps: 1) Select an AGV 2) Select Go to 3) Select which square 4) Select Confirm.”

steps.title: Select the AGV that is not in a task
steps.purpose: Ensure the Go-to command is issued to an AGV that is eligible per the segment’s use case (“not in a task”).
steps.instruction: In Robot Selection, select the AGV that is “not in a task.”
steps.expected_result: The intended AGV is selected in the Robot Selection area (i.e., the UI reflects that AGV as the active selection).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected AGV is the one you intend to recover (the segment’s prerequisite: “AGV not in a task”).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify an AGV that is “not in a task,” or the wrong AGV is selected.

actions.label: Select eligible AGV
actions.exact_action: Select the AGV that is “not in a task.”

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/segment text: “Robot Selection Go-to function… AGV not in a task can be sent to any square.”

steps.title: Select the Go-to function
steps.purpose: Switch the UI into the Go-to workflow for the selected AGV.
steps.instruction: Select the “Go to” function for the selected AGV.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to option/workflow becomes active in the UI for the selected AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: Go-to is active and ready for destination square selection.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting Go-to does not activate the workflow (e.g., destination square selection is not enabled/available).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide steps in segment: “2. Select Go to” and OCR shows the Go-to workflow steps.

steps.title: Select the destination square
steps.purpose: Choose where the AGV should be sent.
steps.instruction: Select which square you want the AGV to go to (destination square).
steps.expected_result: The destination square is selected/highlighted in the UI.
steps.healthy_condition: A valid destination square is highlighted/selected for the Go-to command.
steps.failure_condition: No destination square can be selected, or the wrong square is highlighted.

actions.label: Choose destination square
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to (destination square).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide steps in segment: “3. Select which square you want the AGV to go to.”

steps.title: Select Confirm to send the AGV
steps.purpose: Issue the Go-to command to move the selected AGV to the selected destination square.
steps.expected_result: After Confirm, the selected AGV is commanded to move to the chosen destination square (e.g., drop it off at the hospital per the segment’s example).
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV begins moving toward the selected destination square after Confirm.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm, stop and escalate to support for deeper diagnostics (the segment does not provide troubleshooting steps).
If the AGV still cannot pick up a new task after the tote is removed, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/segment text: “AGV not in a task can be sent to any square… use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital. The AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed.” and slide steps include “4. Select Confirm.”

success_criteria: After selecting Confirm, the selected AGV moves to the chosen destination square.
After the tote is removed, the AGV can pick up a new task.
healthy_conditions: AGV responds to the Go-to Confirm by moving to the selected destination square.
Once the tote is removed, the AGV picks up a new task.
failure_conditions: AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm.
AGV still cannot pick up a new task after the tote is removed.
escalation_guidance: If the AGV does not move after Confirm, stop and escalate to support for deeper diagnostics (no troubleshooting steps are provided in the segment).
If the AGV still cannot pick up a new task after the tote is removed, stop and escalate.
